name: hygiene-check-fails-on-pnpm-version-mismatch
hook: Hygiene CI fails with pnpm version mismatch between workflow and package.json
body: The `repo-hygiene-report.yml` workflow specified `pnpm/action-setup@v4` with `version: 10`, but `package.json` had `packageManager: "pnpm@10.33.0"`. This caused `ERR_PNPM_BAD_PM_VERSION` and CI failure. Fix: align the workflow version with package.json.
why: When the workflow's pnpm version doesn't match the package.json specification, the pnpm/action-setup@v4 action rejects the mismatch with a hard error, failing the workflow before it even runs the hygiene script.
